propositions: Ambient env reads (os.environ subscript/get or os.getenv with string-literal key) below approved composition roots must be detected and flagged with env-name, path, and owning seam.

Helper-shim env reads whose resolved callee is in gen_env_registry.KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS must be resolved one-level via that table; shim-shaped callees absent from the table or dynamic env-name arguments fail closed as unresolved-env-read.
load_config calls outside approved composition roots and credential-boundary modules must be detected via callee aliasing (direct, import alias, local alias) and flagged.
Receiver-object aliasing (src = os.environ; src.get/src[...]) must be resolved to detect ambient and credential reads that would otherwise evade detection.
Provider-credential reads (env-names from _child_env.owned_secret_names or _ADAPTER_SECRET_NAMES) outside their approved credential-boundary set must be flagged with path, symbol, and owning seam.

The approved-seam registry must derive owner sets at runtime from existing registries (gen_env_registry.scan + _deprecations + @register decorators + _child_env), reject path-glob exceptions structurally, and fail when a newly declared env spelling or credential name lacks an owner.
